content.text: {"core": "Compassion joins across separation, matching its state to another's. In Faith, it operates on the suspended stance: a hold that stays open without resolving. Too Much, the joining floods the suspension — every held position is met and merged before it completes its work, so the stance can no longer bear weight alone. The hold dissolves into the meeting.", "sheetLine": "The waiting is being filled from outside before it finishes its own work."}
